## Record interpretation

- This repository continues the notice sequence from 0015 onward.
- Historical records remain in their original archive; no migration or duplication is performed.
- Use the notice index to discover issued records.
- Preserve notice identifiers, dates, attribution and original record context.
- Distinguish published statements from external interpretations.
- Do not infer timestamp verification solely from the existence of an OpenTimestamps receipt.
- Corrections are recorded separately; issued notices are preserved.
